2	// Package domain holds all rich domain models and domain logic that underpin
3	// CanvasCaster’s core engine.  No persistence- or transport-specific concerns
4	// should leak into this layer.
5	package domain
6	
7	import (
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"sync"
11		"time"
12	
13		"github.com/google/uuid"
14	)
15	
16	//------------------------------------------------------------
17	// Value Objects / Strongly-Typed IDs
18	//------------------------------------------------------------
19	
20	// StoryboardID uniquely identifies a storyboard across the entire platform.
21	type StoryboardID string
22	
23	// NewStoryboardID returns a new storyboard identifier.
24	func NewStoryboardID() StoryboardID { return StoryboardID(uuid.NewString()) }
25	
26	// PanelID uniquely identifies a panel *inside* a storyboard.
27	type PanelID string
28	
29	// newPanelID returns a new panel identifier (unexported; panels are created
30	// only through storyboard methods).
31	func newPanelID() PanelID { return PanelID(uuid.NewString()) }
32	
33	// TenantID isolates storyboard data within the multi-tenant platform.
34	type TenantID string
35	
36	//------------------------------------------------------------
37	// Domain Errors
38	//------------------------------------------------------------
39	
40	var (
41		ErrPanelNotFound          = errors.New("panel not found")
42		ErrStoryboardArchived     = errors.New("storyboard is archived")
43		ErrStoryboardDeleted      = errors.New("storyboard is deleted")
44		ErrPanelCountExceeded     = errors.New("panel count exceeded storyboard limit")
45		ErrInvalidCloneTarget     = errors.New("cannot clone: original panel not found")
46		ErrConcurrentModification = errors.New("concurrent modification detected")
47	)
48	
49	//------------------------------------------------------------
50	// Domain Events
51	//------------------------------------------------------------
52	
53	// DomainEvent is published by aggregates when a state change occurs.  Interfaces
54	// at the application/service layer can subscribe and persist/dispatch them.
55	type DomainEvent interface {
56		Name() string
57		OccurredAt() time.Time
58	}
59	
60	type baseEvent struct {
61		name string
62		at   time.Time
63	}
64	
65	func (e baseEvent) Name() string      { return e.name }
66	func (e baseEvent) OccurredAt() time.Time { return e.at }
67	
68	// PanelAddedEvent is emitted when a new panel is appended to the storyboard.
69	type PanelAddedEvent struct {
70		baseEvent
71		StoryboardID StoryboardID
72		PanelID      PanelID
73		AddedBy      string
74		Index        int
75	}
76	
77	// PanelClonedEvent is emitted when an existing panel is cloned.
78	type PanelClonedEvent struct {
79		baseEvent
80		StoryboardID StoryboardID
81		OriginalID   PanelID
82		CloneID      PanelID
83		Palette      Palette
84		ClonedBy     string
85	}
86	
87	//------------------------------------------------------------
88	// Supporting Value Objects
89	//------------------------------------------------------------
90	
91	// Palette is a tiny value object representing an artist’s color palette.
92	type Palette struct {
93		Name  string   // e.g. “Warm Tones”
94		Swatch []Color // HEX colors, length constrained elsewhere
95	}
96	
97	// Color represents a single RGB color encoded as a hex string “#RRGGBB”.
98	type Color string
99	
100	//------------------------------------------------------------
101	// Panel Aggregate Root
102	//------------------------------------------------------------
103	
104	// Panel is an immutable snapshot of a storyboard frame.  Any “mutation” to a
105	// panel results in versioning at storyboard level rather than in-place update.
106	type Panel struct {
107		ID        PanelID
108		Index     int       // zero-based position within the storyboard Frames slice
109		CreatedAt time.Time // when the panel was added
110		CreatedBy string    // user handle / id
111		// In a fuller model, we would have: Layers []Layer, SpeechBubbles []Bubble, etc.
112		// Those are omitted here to keep the code snippet focused on storyboard logic.
113	}
114	
115	// Clone returns a deep copy of the panel with a new identifier, index and
116	// creation metadata; caller is responsible for injecting it into the storyboard.
117	func (p Panel) Clone(index int, by string) Panel {
118		return Panel{
119			ID:        newPanelID(),
120			Index:     index,
121			CreatedAt: time.Now().UTC(),
122			CreatedBy: by,
123		}
124	}
125	
126	//------------------------------------------------------------
127	// Storyboard Aggregate Root
128	//------------------------------------------------------------
129	
130	// Storyboard is the principal aggregate for the creative canvas.  It enforces
131	// all invariants related to panel order, versioning, and high-level creative
132	// commands.  Concurrency control is done with an optimistic “Version” field.
133	type Storyboard struct {
134		mu sync.RWMutex // protects the entire aggregate from concurrent goroutines
135	
136		// Identity
137		ID       StoryboardID
138		TenantID TenantID
139	
140		// Metadata
141		Name        string
142		Description string
143		CreatedAt   time.Time
144		UpdatedAt   time.Time
145		ArchivedAt  *time.Time // non-nil when the storyboard is archived
146		DeletedAt   *time.Time // non-nil when the storyboard is soft-deleted
147	
148		Version uint // incremented every mutating call for optimistic locking
149	
150		// Children
151		Panels []Panel
152	
153		// Pending domain events to be dispatched by the application layer.
154		pending []DomainEvent
155	
156		// Domain rules
157		maxPanels int
158	}
159	
160	// NewStoryboard creates a brand-new storyboard aggregate root.
161	func NewStoryboard(tenantID TenantID, name, description string, createdBy string) *Storyboard {
162		now := time.Now().UTC()
163		sb := &Storyboard{
164			ID:         NewStoryboardID(),
165			TenantID:   tenantID,
166			Name:       name,
167			Description: description,
168			CreatedAt:  now,
169			UpdatedAt:  now,
170			Version:    1,
171			maxPanels:  500, // reasonable default; can be overridden for enterprise plans
172		}
173		// A storyboard is born with its first panel, index 0.
174		sb.addPanelInternal(createdBy)
175		return sb
176	}
177	
178	//------------------------------------------------------------
179	// Aggregate Root Operations
180	//------------------------------------------------------------
181	
182	// AddPanel appends a new panel at the end of the storyboard.
183	func (s *Storyboard) AddPanel(createdBy string) (Panel, error) {
184		s.mu.Lock()
185		defer s.mu.Unlock()
186		if err := s.guardMutability(); err != nil {
187			return Panel{}, err
188		}
189		if len(s.Panels) >= s.maxPanels {
190			return Panel{}, ErrPanelCountExceeded
191		}
192		p := s.addPanelInternal(createdBy)
193		s.bumpVersion()
194		return p, nil
195	}
196	
197	// ClonePanel duplicates an existing panel (referenced by id) and inserts the
198	// clone *right after* the original.  The clone may optionally adopt a new
199	// color palette suggestion (purely metadata here for the snippet).
200	func (s *Storyboard) ClonePanel(originalID PanelID, palette Palette, clonedBy string) (Panel, error) {
201		s.mu.Lock()
202		defer s.mu.Unlock()
203		if err := s.guardMutability(); err != nil {
204			return Panel{}, err
205		}
206		origIdx := s.indexOf(originalID)
207		if origIdx == -1 {
208			return Panel{}, ErrInvalidCloneTarget
209		}
210		if len(s.Panels) >= s.maxPanels {
211			return Panel{}, ErrPanelCountExceeded
212		}
213	
214		// Create clone
215		cloneIdx := origIdx + 1
216		clone := s.Panels[origIdx].Clone(cloneIdx, clonedBy)
217	
218		// Re-index existing panels after insertion point.
219		s.Panels = append(s.Panels, Panel{})      // grow slice
220		copy(s.Panels[cloneIdx+1:], s.Panels[cloneIdx:])
221		s.Panels[cloneIdx] = clone
222		for i := cloneIdx + 1; i < len(s.Panels); i++ {
223			s.Panels[i].Index = i
224		}
225	
226		// Event
227		s.recordEvent(PanelClonedEvent{
228			baseEvent:    baseEvent{name: "PanelCloned", at: time.Now().UTC()},
229			StoryboardID: s.ID,
230			OriginalID:   originalID,
231			CloneID:      clone.ID,
232			Palette:      palette,
233			ClonedBy:     clonedBy,
234		})
235	
236		s.bumpVersion()
237		return clone, nil
238	}
239	
240	// RemovePanel deletes a panel from the storyboard.  For simplicity we do *not*
241	// keep tombstones here; audit/logs & versioning are handled at higher layers.
242	func (s *Storyboard) RemovePanel(panelID PanelID) error {
243		s.mu.Lock()
244		defer s.mu.Unlock()
245		if err := s.guardMutability(); err != nil {
246			return err
247		}
248		idx := s.indexOf(panelID)
249		if idx == -1 {
250			return ErrPanelNotFound
251		}
252		s.Panels = append(s.Panels[:idx], s.Panels[idx+1:]...)
253		for i := idx; i < len(s.Panels); i++ {
254			s.Panels[i].Index = i
255		}
256		s.bumpVersion()
257		return nil
258	}
259	
260	// Archive marks the storyboard read-only.
261	func (s *Storyboard) Archive() error {
262		s.mu.Lock()
263		defer s.mu.Unlock()
264		if s.ArchivedAt != nil {
265			return nil // idempotent
266		}
267		now := time.Now().UTC()
268		s.ArchivedAt = &now
269		s.bumpVersion()
270		return nil
271	}
272	
273	// Delete performs a soft-delete, preventing any further access except for
274	// privileged recovery operations.
275	func (s *Storyboard) Delete() error {
276		s.mu.Lock()
277		defer s.mu.Unlock()
278		if s.DeletedAt != nil {
279			return nil // idempotent
280		}
281		now := time.Now().UTC()
282		s.DeletedAt = &now
283		s.bumpVersion()
284		return nil
285	}
286	
287	//------------------------------------------------------------
288	// Query Helpers
289	//------------------------------------------------------------
290	
291	// PanelsCount returns number of panels (thread-safe read).
292	func (s *Storyboard) PanelsCount() int {
293		s.mu.RLock()
294		defer s.mu.RUnlock()
295		return len(s.Panels)
296	}
297	
298	// AllEvents returns and *clears* pending domain events.
299	func (s *Storyboard) AllEvents() []DomainEvent {
300		s.mu.Lock()
301		defer s.mu.Unlock()
302		evts := s.pending
303		s.pending = nil
304		return evts
305	}
306	
307	//------------------------------------------------------------
308	// Internal helpers – not exported
309	//------------------------------------------------------------
310	
311	func (s *Storyboard) guardMutability() error {
312		if s.ArchivedAt != nil {
313			return ErrStoryboardArchived
314		}
315		if s.DeletedAt != nil {
316			return ErrStoryboardDeleted
317		}
318		return nil
319	}
320	
321	func (s *Storyboard) indexOf(id PanelID) int {
322		for i, p := range s.Panels {
323			if p.ID == id {
324				return i
325			}
326		}
327		return -1
328	}
329	
330	func (s *Storyboard) addPanelInternal(createdBy string) Panel {
331		index := len(s.Panels)
332		panel := Panel{
333			ID:        newPanelID(),
334			Index:     index,
335			CreatedAt: time.Now().UTC(),
336			CreatedBy: createdBy,
337		}
338		s.Panels = append(s.Panels, panel)
339	
340		s.recordEvent(PanelAddedEvent{
341			baseEvent:    baseEvent{name: "PanelAdded", at: time.Now().UTC()},
342			StoryboardID: s.ID,
343			PanelID:      panel.ID,
344			AddedBy:      createdBy,
345			Index:        index,
346		})
347	
348		return panel
349	}
350	
351	func (s *Storyboard) bumpVersion() {
352		s.Version++
353		s.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
354	}
355	
356	func (s *Storyboard) recordEvent(e DomainEvent) {
357		s.pending = append(s.pending, e)
358	}
359	
360	//------------------------------------------------------------
361	// String Representation
362	//------------------------------------------------------------
363	
364	func (s *Storyboard) String() string {
365		s.mu.RLock()
366		defer s.mu.RUnlock()
367		state := "ACTIVE"
368		if s.ArchivedAt != nil {
369			state = "ARCHIVED"
370		}
371		if s.DeletedAt != nil {
372			state = "DELETED"
373		}
374		return fmt.Sprintf("Storyboard<%s> [%s] Panels=%d Version=%d",
375			s.ID, state, len(s.Panels), s.Version)
376	}
